Services

Four things, done right here.

Haircut

How walk-ins work

Before you head over.

No appointments

Antique Barber Shop is a walk-in only barber shop. There's nothing to book. Come in and take the next chair.

A second barber

One barber opens the shop and a second joins later in the morning. Saturday has two barbers all day. The times are under the hours below.

Parking

Two parking lots off South Main St.
